title: Monsoon per-city input
description: Everything a human or agent authors for ONE city added through scripts/add_city.py. One file per city: data/cities/<slug>.json, slug = scripts/check-city-ids.mjs convention (NFD, strip accents, non-alnum -> '-'). Climate (high/low/hum/rain) and PM2.5 are NOT authored here: they come from the pipeline (WMO station normals -> ERA5; CAMS scaled to WHO). Cost lives in data/cost-evidence/<slug>.json. Every number needs a recorded source, or an explicit editorial-estimate label with a rationale. Only record URLs you actually opened and that support the figure. Validated by scripts/city_inputs.py (no external jsonschema dependency; this file documents the contract and drives the required-field checks). See docs/adding-a-city.md.

name.description: Display name, unique in the catalog. Disambiguate with a parenthetical like existing entries: 'Chania (Crete)', 'Funchal (Madeira)'.

country.description: Country label as used elsewhere in the catalog (e.g. 'Czech Republic', 'Bosnia & Herzegovina', 'Turkey').

iso3.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3. Used for the World Bank homicide baseline and the WHO air-quality match.

region.description: Catalog region (existing: Africa, E Asia, E Europe, LATAM, N America, N Europe, Oceania, S America, S Europe, SE Asia, W Asia, W Europe; new regions are allowed).

coordsNote.description: What the point is (city centre / the nomad district). Climate stations are matched from this point, so it matters.

visa.description: null = use the country rule in scripts/add_visa.py (required to exist). Otherwise per-passport rules, verified on an official page.

tier.description: 0 Limited, 1 Tourist zones, 2 Good in town, 3 Widespread (EF EPI country band, +1 for an expat hub well ahead of it).

note.description: Exactly the label for the tier, optionally + ' (expat hub — above national average)'.

draw.description: Short category, e.g. 'Beach / winter sun'. Existing voice: 'City / coast', 'Culture / Yucatán'.

vibe.description: One line, factual, no unsupported superlatives.

narrative.description: Two sentences in the existing city-sheet voice (concrete places and things; one honest caveat).

season.description: Editorial estimate: tourist-season phase per month (crowds/prices), Jan..Dec.

hazards.description: Per-month hazard flags (risk 1 = elevated: weather score x0.8; 2 = severe: x0.55). Typhoon/hurricane/monsoon/extreme heat/smoke/haze. At most one entry per month. Each needs a source.

note.description: Short label in the existing style: 'Summer heat', 'Typhoon season', 'Hurricane season', 'Extreme heat (100F+)'.

swim.description: null when there is no seasonally swimmable open water. Months = water warm enough for most swimmers (roughly >= 20-21 °C sea temperature).

events.description: The city-sheet event calendar; the Events score derives from it (scripts/reconcile_events.py --derive). Tier rubric (docs/data-changes/2026-10-03-events.md): 3 = genuinely major, travel-worthy festival for that city, worth planning a stay around; 2 = notable (a national holiday, local city day or religious feast without a draw for visitors is at most 2); 1 = minor or recurring. Movable feasts list every month they can fall in. Blurbs: short and factual, never invented.

safety.description: Inputs to the Safety v3 index (scripts/safety_v3.py formula). Violent sub-score comes from the homicide rate: World Bank/UNODC country baseline (data/worldbank-homicide.json) unless homicideOverride cites a city/region figure. propertySub, touristMod and womensAdj are EDITORIAL ESTIMATES: each needs a 1-2 sentence rationale and the list of what was consulted, calibrated against named comparable cities already in the catalog.

propertyNote.description: Short phrase shown as the property source, e.g. 'Tourist-zone pickpocketing; calm overall'.

womensAdj.description: City delta on the country Gallup women's feel-safe baseline (display only).

touristTags.description: Reuse existing tags: petty-theft, bag-snatching, scams-common, tourist-zones-safer, women-safety-caution, very-low-crime, expat-haven, nightlife-risk, violence-elsewhere-in-state, protest-unrest, tourist-safe.

calibratedAgainst.description: Existing catalog city names the editorial values were calibrated against.

advisory.description: U.S. State Department advisory (reference only; never changes a score). Level/date from the advisory page itself.

date.description: Date the advisory was issued/updated, as shown on the page.

risks.description: Risk indicators named on the page, e.g. Terrorism, Crime, Unrest, Kidnapping or hostage taking.

regionalLevel.description: Level for the city's state/region where the advisory differs (default = level).

localLevel.description: Level that applies at the city itself (default = regionalLevel). >= 3 shows a badge.

climateAir.description: Optional manual hold-backs for the climate/air pipeline (e.g. a documented smog season the model misses). A held-back metric has no fallback for a new city, so it keeps the city pending.

selection.description: One line: why this city was added (copied into the data-changes log).

quote.description: Short verbatim snippet (<= 25 words) that supports the figure.
